# v0.5 acceptance fixtures

Deterministic seeds, sample 30-card action decks, and the four Justin roster rows used by `tests/acceptance/v05`.

These JSON files are test input. They are not catalog records: identity fields use `rosterId` / `defId` so data validation does not treat them as new characters. Sheet stats other than Justina Moment's Saving Grace are `PROPOSED` samples. No gacha rates are stored here.
